# T-1: Refactor PromptBuilder API

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Replace the generic PromptBuilder.add API with explicit addUserPrompt and addSystemPrompt methods while preserving setter behavior and build output fields.

## Acceptance Criteria
- src/lib/prompt-builder.js exports PromptBuilder with addUserPrompt and addSystemPrompt.
- PromptBuilder.add is removed.
- build() returns systemPrompt, userPrompt, jsonSchema, and fmtFallback.
- System sections render after role/rules and before userPrompt.

## Implementation Notes
Keep PromptBuilder provider-agnostic. Use arrays for system/user sections rather than object literals with discriminators.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests under specs/256-prompt-cache-review/tests for section ordering, overwrite setters, jsonSchema/fmtFallback pass-through, and missing add().
